title.purpose: Episode or song title under the cover.

volume.purpose: "Volume 40%" in place of the elapsed time during Option + scroll.

body.purpose: Artist or show line, list rows.

label.purpose: Hint pills and uppercase list headings.

control.purpose: The text of a pill and the chapter menu.

shadows.name: cover-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the cover so it sits above the panel glass.

shadows.name: back-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the back of the cover.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: New cover artwork coming into focus; the title rises 6pt with it.

motion.name: cover-turn
motion.purpose: The cover turning over to show its list.

motion.name: give
motion.purpose: The cover yielding under the pointer.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Replaces every motion above when Reduce Motion is on.

motion.name: row-light
motion.purpose: Every row's hover light coming and going.

components.name: Hint Pill
components.description: Glass capsule on the cover's corner naming what's on the back.
components.html: Album
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 600 10px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(70,70,80,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.3); transition: transform .25s; } .ds-hint:hover { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-hint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Resume Row
components.description: A plain row under the controls while music interrupts a podcast, with its R key.
components.css: .ds-resume { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 240px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px transparent; transition: background .15s ease-out, box-shadow .15s ease-out; } .ds-resume:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.10); } .ds-resume:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-resume:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-resume-art { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#e08a9a,#b8905c); flex: none; } .ds-resume-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-resume-title { font-size: 12px; } .ds-resume-detail { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-keycap { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(235,235,245,.3); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.18); }

components.name: Mini Note
components.description: The mini player's one note at a time, on Note Glass so it reads over any artwork or list.
components.css: .ds-mini-note { width: 224px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.85); color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); font: 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: A song in an album on the back of the cover; the current one is lit; every row lights white at 10% under the pointer and Row Light when pressed.

components.css: .ds-rows { width: 228px; padding: 6px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,40,95,.85), rgba(40,18,60,.85)); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 12px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #fff; transition: background .15s; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-cur { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); font-weight: 600; } .ds-key { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-foot { text-align: center; padding-top: 6px; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); } .ds-n { width: 18px; text-align: right; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-t { flex: 1; } .ds-d { color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); } .ds-row:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }

components.name: Tab Switch
components.description: Episodes | Notes on the back of a podcast's cover.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; width: 228px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; padding: 3px 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); } .ds-on { background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Progress Line and Controls
components.description: A bold white progress line with the times under its ends, then back, play/pause and forward as plain symbols.
components.css: .ds-line { width: 240px; color: #fff; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); overflow: hidden; transition: height .15s; } .ds-track:hover { height: 8px; } .ds-track i { display: block; width: 30%; height: 100%; background: #fff; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-times { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 4px; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ctl { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 26px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-ctl button { background: none; border: 0; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; padding: 6px; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-ctl button:hover { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-ctl button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-ctl .ds-play { font-size: 26px; }

components.name: Source Dot
components.description: 6pt dot after the artist name saying where a song plays.

narrative.overview:
sideB is a cover you can turn over. On the front, what's playing and nothing else; on the back, the album, the playlist or the episodes it belongs to. It hangs at the edge of the author's work in the menu bar, is touched for a moment, and is gone. It should feel **tactile, calm and precise**: the cover gives under the pointer and turns like a real sleeve, nothing shouts, every detail is exact.

The material is the see-through window glass macOS draws (AppKit `NSGlassEffectView`): the desktop and the windows behind show through the panel and the mini player, so sideB takes its colour from where it sits and from the artwork it shows: the glass itself is tinted with the cover's colour. sideB adds no colour of its own. Density is low and deliberate: a 272 pt panel holds a 240 pt cover, a title, the progress line and its controls and, under them, only what the moment needs: a note, the chapter menu, the Resume row or Up Next.

The iPod lineage survives in the love of album covers and the click-wheel icon, not in a wheel: sideB tried a dial and dropped it for a progress line and plain buttons. No Apple assets or logos appear; the playback buttons use Apple's SF Symbols so they read as the Mac's own, and every other glyph is drawn in code.
keyCharacteristics: Window glass everywhere the app has a surface; SwiftUI glass only for small controls inside it.
Colour comes from artwork and the desktop; sideB's own ink is white at a few opacities.
System type (SF Pro) at small, exact sizes; tabular digits for every time.
Soft springs for every change; Reduce Motion always gets a plain crossfade.
One gesture per thing: drag or scroll the progress line, press play, click the cover.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: sideB never paints a surface with a colour of its own. Colour comes from the artwork (the Glass Tint and the Cover Tint), the desktop through the glass, or the two source dots.

rules.name: The Label Ink Rule
rules.body: Anything that must read as white on glass uses `NSColor.labelColor`; `.primary` and `.foreground` render grey there.

rules.name: The Same Size Rule
rules.body: Paired values keep one size: elapsed and remaining times never shrink independently; when space runs out, move them rather than scale them.

rules.name: The Steady Controls Rule
rules.body: The progress line and playback buttons stay put from song to song: a title that wraps never moves them under the pointer.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the cover lifts. Pills, rows, the progress line and the buttons sit in the glass, not on it.

rules.name: The Parallel Corners Rule
rules.body: An inner radius is the outer radius less the gap between them.

dos: **Do** put window glass (`NSGlassEffectView`) behind every surface that should see the desktop: the panel and the mini player, tinted with the cover's colour.
**Do** keep the panel and the mini player in the dark appearance (`darkAqua`), so that ink stays white in Light mode too.
**Do** nest corners: 30 pt panel → 14 pt cover → 8 pt rows → 6 pt thumbs.
**Do** use tabular digits for every time and number.
**Do** give every motion a Reduce Motion crossfade.

**Do** use SF Symbols for the playback buttons (`backward.fill`, `play.fill` / `pause.fill` with the symbol replace transition, `forward.fill`; `gobackward.15` and `goforward.30` for podcasts) and draw the other glyphs in code (library, show and hide the mini player, the turn mark), never Unicode arrows.
donts: **Don't** use SwiftUI `.glassEffect` for a whole window's surface: it only sees inside its own clear window and renders flat grey.
**Don't** use Apple logos or product artwork; keep SF Symbols to the playback buttons.
**Don't** shrink one of a pair of values (elapsed and remaining time) to make it fit.
**Don't** add a window shadow to the panel; the glass carries its own.
**Don't** use up and down arrows (⌄ ⌃) on the cover's hint: the cover turns sideways, it doesn't drop down.
**Don't** put account controls on the back of the cover.
**Don't** hide the panel's controls until hover; show them faintly at rest. The mini player is the one exception: at rest it is only the cover, by design.
**Don't** open a second window for something the panel can show in place (the list lives on the back of the cover).
**Don't** paint surfaces with sideB's own colour.
